title: kp-github shared developer-events configuration v1
description: Nonsecret operator configuration before kpghcfg1_ packing. This schema checks structure; the pack command additionally validates URL ports, UTF-8 byte limits and case-insensitive organization uniqueness. Sample validity does not mean the receiver is deployed or the configuration is production-ready.

endpoint.description: Consumer API base URL, distinct from GitHub webhook ingress. HTTPS only; no user information, query, fragment, backslash, whitespace or control characters. At most 2048 UTF-8 bytes; port must be 1 through 65535 if specified. The authoritative pack validator performs the byte-length and URL-port checks.

audience.description: Receiver-approved Google ID-token audience, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. Must match receiver verification policy; a human gcloud account cannot mint an arbitrary custom audience. No whitespace or control characters.

allowed_orgs.description: Allowed GitHub organizations. The pack command additionally enforces case-insensitive uniqueness. This local list is not a server authorization grant.

app_slug.description: Optional GitHub App slug; public metadata only.
